::: {#sol-autograd-vs-hand}

```{python}
#| code-fold: show
slope_gap = abs(slope_by_autograd.item() - slope_by_hand)
print(slope_by_autograd.item(), slope_by_hand, slope_gap)
```

The two slopes differ by `r format(py$slope_gap, digits = 2)`,
`r if (py$slope_gap == 0) "so they are equal" else "a floating-point rounding error"`:
both are `r sprintf("%.4f", py$slope_by_hand)` to four decimal places.

:::
